verdict.rationale: Kimi's first-party docs say users operate the product through conversation: the Desktop and CLI agents read code, edit files, run commands and verify results via chat, and the consumer app invites users to just ask or start an Agent task. Community users corroborate hands-on prompt-driven use of the web interface and coding agent. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the scope and limits of natural-language control in the consumer assistant app (help entries are only topic headings).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
